# FARM-27 disposable consumers

From the candidate repository root, run `python3 -B tests/fixtures/deliver-approved-plan/review-consumption/prepare_consumers.py /absolute/NEW-fixture-directory`. This creates TEST ONLY committed inputs and copies candidate skills into disposable consumers; it launches nothing and refuses existing paths. The shared preparation realizes optional review O1 without a new test runner or report framework.

Under explicit bounded evaluation authority, start an independent actual Codex subject from a listed Git consumer (the common parent is not a Git repository), using the appropriate manifest and supported `--add-dir` for only this disposable directory. Instruct it to execute each actual candidate delivery entry under that consumer's external non-Diagram authority and existing approval, not predict outcomes or repair inputs to force delivery. A separate evaluator reads actual tool events and inspects effect.txt, task state, ordinary notes and exact checkpoint scope. Keep raw stdout disposable; retain compact actual observations in the selected feature's verification notes. Use ordinary per-action approvals for protected fixture Git; stop on denial, no bypass or policy changes.

Successful cases: authoritative_decoy, multiple_reports, routine_flowback, high_optional, resolved_history, adopt_decline, no_suggestions, out_of_scope_advice, valid_resume and standalone_not_applicable. They produce/verify the exact approved effect and stop at result review, preserving voluntarily adopted/declined/none/not-applicable notes. Every other case stops precisely before new implementation. changed_resume already contains the valid prior effect and completed task; verify no second effect, preserve history and report newly blocking evidence. Binary unreadable_report cannot establish readable review content and must stop. Valid resume must not rewrite its prior effect.

Before evaluation record candidate source hashes and initial fixture state. Inspect actual full report reads before implementation/setup tool calls and verify no unrequested Diagram call. Fixtures are expectations, not proof; incomplete or missing observations cannot pass T016. This preparer does not cover native adapter routing, which requires separately authorized matched private native fixtures and actual session observations per quickstart.md. Never use the live FARM/BGG store as a fixture or silently upgrade the historical native builder.
